name: unnerving mask
desc:
When a creature the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster}, the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} can create the illusion that it looks like one of the creature's departed loved ones or bitter enemies. If the creature can see the [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster}, it must succeed on a  DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened until the end of its turn.
The [[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} can create the illusion that it looks like one of the creature's departed loved ones or bitter enemies. Make a Wisdom saving throw.
